_help: The Privacy page. Plain-English draft: have a lawyer check it before taking payments. Keep it matching what the site really collects. Lines starting with TODO are placeholders.
title: Privacy policy
intro: web3.toys is built so you can play without telling us anything. This page lists exactly what we collect, why, who helps us store it, and how to delete it.

sections.title: If you just play
list: Your progress, coins, certificates and tool inputs are saved in your own browser (local storage). They are not sent to us.
Tools run in your browser. What you type into a tool is not sent anywhere.
We count simple page events (a toy was opened, finished or shared) without your name, to see which toys people like.

sections.title: If you create an account
list: Your login: your email address, or your X or Google account id, plus the name and profile picture that service shares with us. We never get your password.
When and which version of this policy you agreed to.
Your progress: toys played, scores, certificates, Pro tags, rank, coins and cosmetic extras, so you can see them on any device and on the leaderboard.

You get a random cartoon picture and a random fun display name (like SleepyFrog42). We do not show your real name or your X or Google picture. The leaderboard shows only your display name, picture, rank and coins. You can change your name or get a new picture any time.
If you join through someone's invite link, we store who invited you, so both of you can get the invite bonus. If you claim the X post task, we keep the link to your post so we can check it.

sections.title: If you buy something
list: What you bought, the price, the date and the payment reference, so we can give you your download and a receipt.
Card and UPI payments are handled by Razorpay. Your card, UPI or bank details go to Razorpay, not to us. Razorpay's own privacy policy applies to them.
Crypto payments are handled by Paymento. You pay from your own wallet; we see the order and its status, and like every blockchain payment, the transaction is public on the blockchain.
Calls booked through Cal.com are handled by Cal.com and its payment provider.

sections.title: If you join the email list or send a project request
list: Your email address and the page you signed up from, to send you the updates you asked for. Every email has an unsubscribe link.
For project requests: your name, email, project details and payment status, to review and deliver your request.

sections.title: Who helps us
list: Supabase (accounts, database and private file storage).
Vercel (hosting the website).
Razorpay (card and UPI payments, and receipts).
Paymento (crypto payments).
Cal.com (booking calls).
Our email provider (login links and receipts).
We do not sell your data and we do not use advertising trackers.

sections.title: How long we keep it
list: Account and progress data: until you delete your account.
Purchase records: as long as the law requires us to keep financial records, even after you delete your account.
Email list: until you unsubscribe.

sections.title: Deleting your data
list: Logged in: open My account and tap "Delete my account and data". Your account, progress and coins are deleted straight away and cannot be brought back.
Browser data: the same button also clears web3.toys data saved in that browser. You can also clear it in your browser settings.
Anything else, or if you cannot log in: email us from the Contact page and we will delete it.

sections.title: Your rights
list: You can ask to see, correct or delete the data we hold about you, and withdraw your consent at any time, by emailing us from the Contact page.

sections.title: Age
list: Accounts and purchases are for people aged 18 or over. Anyone younger can play without an account.

sections.title: Changes
list: If we change what we collect, we will update this page and the date at the top, and ask for your agreement again when needed.
